comment.text: POLE P286 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1, v2. Source observations include Bladder tumors; Bowel tumors; Breast carcinoma; Breast tumors; Colorectal carcinoma. Additional source tumor types are retained in the structured record. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting POLE residue P286 have been observed in endometrial carcinoma, colorectal carcinoma, and bladder tumors. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.
